remarks.para: Not referenced directly: loads it by name ("SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools, SysWeaver.Common.Windows") when running on Windows, so the assembly only needs to be deployed with the application.
Uses WMI for the OS name, a "Processor Information" performance counter for CPU usage, GlobalMemoryStatusEx for memory, FlushFileBuffers, ExitWindowsEx and directory ACLs.
The type initializer creates the performance counter and the constructor queries WMI; if the counter can't be created returns false, and if WMI fails falls back to .

member.name: P:SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools.OsFriendlyName
member.summary: The WMI caption of the OS with build number and bitness, ex: "Microsoft Windows 11 Pro build 26100 (64 bits)".

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools.FlushToDisc(System.Runtime.InteropServices.SafeHandle)
member.summary: Flushes the OS buffers of a file to disc using FlushFileBuffers.
member.param: The file handle, must have write access.
member.returns: True if successful, false on failure (ex: a handle without write access). Exceptions (ex: a null handle) are tracked in the stats, a failed FlushFileBuffers call isn't.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools.GetMemorySize(System.UInt64@,System.UInt64@)
member.summary: Gets the physical memory size using GlobalMemoryStatusEx.
member.param: Receives the available physical memory in bytes, 0 on failure.
Receives the total physical memory in bytes, 0 on failure.
member.returns: True if successful, false on failure (the exception is tracked in the stats).

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools.GetCpuUsage(System.Double@)
member.summary: Gets the total CPU usage from the "Processor Information\% Processor Time\_Total" performance counter.
member.param: Receives the CPU usage in percent, 0 on failure.
member.returns: True if successful, false on failure (the exception is tracked in the stats).
member.remarks: The value is averaged over the time since the previous call (by any caller, the counter is shared and calls are serialized).

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools.Reboot
member.summary: Reboots the computer using ExitWindowsEx (planned shutdown, not forced) after enabling the SeShutdownPrivilege.
member.returns: True if the reboot was initiated, false if the privilege couldn't be enabled or the call failed.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools.MakeDirectoryAccessableToEveryOne(System.String)
member.summary: Adds a "full control" access rule for the Everyone group to a directory, unless an equivalent rule exists.
member.returns: null if successful, else the exception that occurred (also tracked in the stats), ex: a .
member.remarks: The rule applies to the directory itself and is inherited by all files and sub directories. An existing Everyone rule only counts if it grants full control to the directory itself and its descendants (so directories processed by older versions, that only got an inherit-only rule, are fixed). A non inherited rule added by older versions (using , only inherited by direct children) is replaced, same as . This makes files and folders created by a service (ex: running as SYSTEM) modifiable by users (without an UAC prompt) and vice versa.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WindowsPlatformTools.TokenAdjuster.EnablePrivilege(System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Enables a privilege (ex: "SeShutdownPrivilege") in the current process token.
member.param: Intended to choose enable/disable, but the privilege is always enabled.
member.returns: True if the privilege was enabled (the process holds it), else false.
